name: Collar & Chain
source:
Needing money to support her ill mother, Abigail applies for a housekeeping job at a mansion. The only issue is, she really sucks at her work... To remedy this, the mansion's owner and her boss, Nora Crescentwood, takes it upon herself to watch over Abigail and whip her into shape. As things worsen at home, how will Nora and Abigail's relationship develop...?
